title: Presentations & Public Speaking
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Ahora tienes las frases clave para dominar cualquier presentación en inglés.

parts.visual:
Estructurando tu presentación: 
- Overview (Visión general). 
- Outline (Esquema/Índice). 
Ej: First, I will give you a brief overview of the project. 
Transiciones: 
- Moving on to... (Pasando a...). 
Ej: Moving on to the next slide (Pasando a la siguiente diapositiva).
parts.audio: Structuring your presentation. Overview means a general summary. Outline is the plan of what you will cover. For example: First, I will give you a brief overview of the project. Transitions. Moving on to means going to the next topic. Moving on to the next slide.

parts.visual:
Elementos visuales y cierre: 
- Slide (Diapositiva). 
- Graph / Chart (Gráfico). 
- Summarize (Resumir). 
Ej: As you can see on this graph... (Como pueden ver en este gráfico...). 
To summarize, we need to reduce costs (Para resumir, necesitamos reducir costos).
parts.audio: Visuals and closing. Slide. Graph or Chart. Summarize means to give a brief statement of the main points. For example: As you can see on this graph. To summarize, we need to reduce costs.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra o frase correcta para tu presentación.

questions.question: Let me share my screen and show you the first ____. (Diapositiva).
questions.explanation: Slide = diapositiva (de PowerPoint, Google Slides, etc.).

questions.question: First, I'll give you a brief ____ of the new strategy. (Visión general / Resumen).
Let's look at the ____ for today's presentation. (Índice / Esquema).
questions.explanation: Outline = esquema, los puntos que se van a tratar.

questions.question: As you can see on this ____, sales have increased. (Gráfico).
____ on to the next point, let's discuss the budget. (Pasando a...).
To ____, we need to focus on customer satisfaction. (Para resumir).
Does anyone have any ____? (Preguntas).
questions.explanation: En inglés no se suele decir 'have doubts' al final de una presentación, se dice 'have questions'.

questions.question: Good morning everyone. Thank you for ____ today. (Asistir / Venir).
questions.explanation: Thank you for + verbo-ing = Thank you for coming (Gracias por venir).

questions.question: The ____ of my presentation is the Q3 results. (Propósito / Tema).
questions.explanation: The purpose of my presentation = El propósito/objetivo de mi presentación.

questions.question: Let's ____ down to business. (Ir al grano / Empezar a trabajar).
questions.explanation: Let's get down to business = Vamos al grano / Manos a la obra.

questions.question: Let me ____ your attention to this chart. (Llamar / Dirigir).
questions.explanation: Draw someone's attention to... = Dirigir la atención de alguien hacia...

questions.question: I have divided my presentation into three ____. (Partes).
This ____ to my next point. (Nos lleva a).
questions.explanation: This leads me to my next point = Esto me lleva a mi siguiente punto.

questions.question: Let's take a closer ____ at the numbers. (Vistazo / Mirada).
questions.explanation: Take a closer look at = echemos un vistazo más de cerca a.

questions.question: I will take questions at the ____ of the presentation. (Final).
As I ____ earlier, our budget is limited. (Mencioné).
questions.explanation: As I mentioned earlier = Como mencioné antes.

questions.question: That covers everything I wanted to ____ today. (Decir / Tratar).
questions.explanation: Everything I wanted to say = Todo lo que quería decir.

questions.question: To ____ up, the project is a success. (Concluir / Resumir).
Let's skip this ____ and go to the next one. (Diapositiva).
questions.explanation: Skip this slide = saltarse esta diapositiva.

questions.question: Can everyone ____ my screen? (Ver).
questions.explanation: Can everyone see my screen? = ¿Todos pueden ver mi pantalla?

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra de presentación correcta.

questions.question: Next ____. (Diapositiva con S)
A brief ____. (Visión general con O)
The presentation ____. (Esquema/Índice con O)
As you see on this ____. (Gráfico con G)
____ on to the next topic. (Pasando a... con M)
To ____, we need to act now. (Resumir con S)
Any ____? (Preguntas con Q)
The ____ of my presentation is... (Propósito con P)
Can you ____ my screen? (Ver)
As I ____ earlier... (Mencioné con M)
